module Tests.Chess where

import DA.Assert
import Daml.Script

import Chess
import Init
import Types

type ResultOrNextGame = Either (ContractId Result) (ContractId Game)

takeMove : Script ResultOrNextGame
  -> (Party, Coord, Coord)
  -> Script ResultOrNextGame
takeMove seg (player, from, to) = do
  eg <- seg
  case eg of
    Left _ -> abort "Can't continue won game"
    Right g -> submit player do
      exerciseCmd g Move with
        move = ChessMove with
                          from
                          to
                          promote = None
                          check = None

testEnum = script do
  let lst = [0..63]
  let coords = [A1 .. H8]
  lst === fmap fromEnum coords

testFoolsMate = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData

  let
    moves = [
      (white, G2, G4),
      (black, E7, E6),
      (white, F2, F4),
      (black, D8, H4),
      (white, E1, F2),
      (black, H4, F2)
      ]
  game <- foldl takeMove (return $ Right game) moves

  Some win <- case game of
    Right _ -> abort "Should be a win"
    Left win -> queryContractId black win

  win.winner === Some black

module Tests.Chess where

import DA.Assert
import Daml.Script

import Chess
import Init
import qualified Rules.Data
import Types

takeMove current (party, from, to) = do
  outcome <- current
  case outcome of
    Left result -> return (Left result)
    Right game -> submit party do
      exerciseCmd game Move with
        move = ChessMove with
          from
          to
          promote = None
          check = None

testProposalAcceptance = script do
  white <- allocateParty "ProposalWhite"
  black <- allocateParty "ProposalBlack"
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "invitation"; white; black

  proposal <- submit white do
    createCmd GameProposal with gameId; proposer = white
  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd proposal StartGame
  game <- submit black do
    exerciseCmd proposal StartGame
  Some started <- queryContractId white game
  started.gameId === gameId
  started.state.player === White
  length started.state.pieces === 32
  started.state.everCheck === (False, False)
  started.state.moves === []
  started.state === Rules.Data.initState ()
  archived <- queryContractId white proposal
  archived === None

testMoveTurnsAndState = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "game"; white; black
  let whiteMove = ChessMove with from = E2; to = E4; promote = None; check = None
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd game Move with move = whiteMove
  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with
      move = ChessMove with from = E2; to = E5; promote = None; check = None

  first <- submit white do
    exerciseCmd game Move with move = whiteMove
  next <- case first of
    Left _ -> abort "Opening move must continue the game"
    Right next -> return next
  Some position <- queryContractId black next
  position.gameId === gameId
  position.state.player === Black
  position.state.moves === [whiteMove]
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd next ClaimDraw
  assert (elem (Piece E4 Pawn White True) position.state.pieces)
  assert (not (elem (Piece E2 Pawn White False) position.state.pieces))
  old <- queryContractId white game
  old === None

  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd next Move with move = whiteMove
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd next Move with move = whiteMove
  let blackMove = ChessMove with from = E7; to = E5; promote = None; check = None
  second <- submit black do
    exerciseCmd next Move with move = blackMove
  case second of
    Left _ -> abort "Second opening move must continue the game"
    Right next -> do
      Some position <- queryContractId white next
      position.state.player === White
      position.state.moves === [blackMove, whiteMove]
      assert (elem (Piece E5 Pawn Black True) position.state.pieces)

testForfeit = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "game"; white; black
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd game Forfeit
  result <- submit white do
    exerciseCmd game Forfeit
  Some outcome <- queryContractId black result
  outcome.winner === Some black
  outcome.game.gameId === gameId
  old <- queryContractId white game
  old === None

  InitData {white = otherWhite, black = otherBlack, game = otherGame} <- initData
  advanced <- submit otherWhite do
    exerciseCmd otherGame Move with
      move = ChessMove with from = D2; to = D4; promote = None; check = None
  current <- case advanced of
    Left _ -> abort "Opening move must continue the game"
    Right current -> return current
  result <- submit otherBlack do
    exerciseCmd current Forfeit
  Some outcome <- queryContractId otherWhite result
  outcome.winner === Some otherWhite
  outcome.game.state.player === Black

testDrawProposal = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "game"; white; black
  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd game ClaimDraw
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd game ClaimDraw

  proposal <- submit white do
    createCmd DrawProposal with gameId; proposer = white
  submitMustFail white do
    exerciseCmd proposal AcceptDraw with game

  let otherId = gameId with ref = "another match"
  otherProposal <- submit white do
    createCmd GameProposal with gameId = otherId; proposer = white
  otherGame <- submit black do
    exerciseCmd otherProposal StartGame
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd proposal AcceptDraw with game = otherGame
  Some _ <- queryContractId white otherGame

  result <- submit black do
    exerciseCmd proposal AcceptDraw with game
  Some outcome <- queryContractId white result
  outcome.winner === None
  outcome.game.gameId === gameId
  old <- queryContractId white game
  old === None
  archived <- queryContractId white proposal
  archived === None

testKingCaptureResult = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "game"; white; black
  let opening = [
        (white, G2, G4),
        (black, E7, E6),
        (white, F2, F4),
        (black, D8, H4),
        (white, E1, F2)
        ]
  position <- foldl takeMove (return (Right game)) opening
  current <- case position of
    Left _ -> abort "Expected a live game before king capture"
    Right current -> return current
  finish <- submit black do
    exerciseCmd current Move with
      move = ChessMove with from = H4; to = F2; promote = None; check = None
  case finish of
    Right _ -> abort "Capturing the king must end the game"
    Left result -> do
      Some outcome <- queryContractId white result
      outcome.winner === Some black
      outcome.game.gameId === gameId
      outcome.game.state.player === Black
      old <- queryContractId white current
      old === None

testBlackProposalAndAgreedDraw = script do
  white <- allocateParty "ReverseWhite"
  black <- allocateParty "ReverseBlack"
  let gameId = GameId with ref = "reverse"; white; black
  invitation <- submit black do
    createCmd GameProposal with gameId; proposer = black
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd invitation StartGame
  game <- submit white do
    exerciseCmd invitation StartGame
  Some started <- queryContractId black game
  started.gameId === gameId
  started.state.player === White

  proposal <- submit black do
    createCmd DrawProposal with gameId; proposer = black
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd proposal AcceptDraw with game
  draw <- submit white do
    exerciseCmd proposal AcceptDraw with game
  Some outcome <- queryContractId black draw
  outcome.winner === None
  outcome.game.state === started.state
  archived <- queryContractId black game
  archived === None

testClaimThreefoldDraw = script do
  InitData {..} <- initData
  let moves = [
        (white, A2, A4),
        (black, A7, A5),
        (white, A1, A3),
        (black, A8, A6),
        (white, A3, A1),
        (black, A6, A8),
        (white, A1, A3),
        (black, A8, A6),
        (white, A3, A1),
        (black, A6, A8),
        (white, A1, A3),
        (black, A8, A6),
        (white, A3, A1),
        (black, A6, A8)
        ]
  position <- foldl takeMove (return (Right game)) moves
  current <- case position of
    Left _ -> abort "Repeated moves must leave a live game"
    Right current -> return current
  submitMustFail black do
    exerciseCmd current ClaimDraw
  result <- submit white do
    exerciseCmd current ClaimDraw
  Some outcome <- queryContractId black result
  outcome.winner === None
  outcome.game.state.player === White
  outcome.game.state.moves === reverse (map (\(_, from, to) -> ChessMove from to None None) moves)
  archived <- queryContractId white current
  archived === None
